public_scan.scope: All released text, including top-level projections and copied history; reviewed binary checked by exact hash and bytes

policy.credentials: values removed; original secret mappings are never written
policy.identities: deterministic pseudonyms; not an irreversible-anonymization claim
policy.paths: machine paths and caller-supplied roots replaced
policy.identifier_words: Whole-token replacement bounded by Unicode letters, digits, underscore and hyphen; longer public identifiers remain intact
policy.terminal_usernames: POSIX long-listing owner fields; whole-token occurrences of usernames discovered from home paths, listings, or explicit input

top_level_discovered_material_policy.credentials: values removed; original secret mappings are never written
top_level_discovered_material_policy.identities: deterministic pseudonyms; not an irreversible-anonymization claim
top_level_discovered_material_policy.paths: machine paths and caller-supplied roots replaced
top_level_discovered_material_policy.identifier_words: Whole-token replacement bounded by Unicode letters, digits, underscore and hyphen; longer public identifiers remain intact
top_level_discovered_material_policy.terminal_usernames: POSIX long-listing owner fields; whole-token occurrences of usernames discovered from home paths, listings, or explicit input

public_scan.automatic_identity_scope: Each new subpackage applies its own full source-material sanitizer; immutable history retains its original verified sanitizer. Cross-package scanning uses explicit private labels, usernames, credentials, machine paths and UUID rules.

replay_scope: Public hashes and source locators; separate normalized analyses and physical accounting; private gate validation is not reproduced publicly
